data.description:
## Description

**What**: Wire parse_failure events from per-bot parsers (d3) into the central telemetry store with a persistent counter keyed on (parser, content_hash). After 3 consecutive CI runs of the same failing comment, auto-file a bug ticket with tag origin:bot-parser-drift. CI exits 0 each time with WARN: to stderr.

**Why**: Parser drift is inevitable as bots evolve their comment formats. Silent failures (current behavior with no counter) accumulate as 'spooky CI flakes.' A persistent counter + auto-bug-file makes drift visible and actionable.

**Scope**:
- IN: central telemetry store schema extension for parse_failure counter; 3-strike threshold; auto-bug-create with tag origin:bot-parser-drift; persistence across CI runs (NOT ARTIFACTS_DIR which doesn't persist)
- OUT: Per-bot parser implementation (covered by d3); telemetry-collect adapter (covered by d2)

## Done Definitions
- When this story is complete, 3 consecutive CI runs of malformed comment -> exactly one bug ticket with tag origin:bot-parser-drift; CI exits 0 each with WARN:
  ← Satisfies: sc-6  (sc-6: "Malformed bot comments do not break CI: parser exits 0 with `WARN:` to stderr; same comment failing parsing in 3 consecutive CI runs auto-files a bug ")
- When this story is complete, Counter persists across CI runs via central store (NOT ARTIFACTS_DIR)
  ← Satisfies: sc-6  (sc-6: "Malformed bot comments do not break CI: parser exits 0 with `WARN:` to stderr; same comment failing parsing in 3 consecutive CI runs auto-files a bug ")
- When this story is complete, 1st/2nd: no ticket; 3rd: one ticket; 4th: no additional
  ← Satisfies: sc-6  (sc-6: "Malformed bot comments do not break CI: parser exits 0 with `WARN:` to stderr; same comment failing parsing in 3 consecutive CI runs auto-files a bug ")

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Counter must persist across CI runs — ARTIFACTS_DIR is per-run; use central telemetry store
- [Maintainability] origin:bot-parser-drift tag enables retro queries for parser-related bugs

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a CI operator, I can rely on parse_failure events being counted in the central telemetry store with auto-bug-file after 3 consecutive failures so bot parser drift becomes actionable rather than silent
